files.title: Welcome to Ansible-Creator Documentation ¶
files.summary: The `ansible-creator` is a Command-Line Interface (CLI) tool designed for effortlessly scaffolding all your Ansible content.

files.title: Installation and Usage ¶
files.summary: ansible-creator provides two main functionalities: `init` and `add`.

files.title: Contributing to ansible-creator ¶
files.summary: To actively contribute to the development and enhancement of ansible-creator, your participation is valued.

files.title: Creating ansible content using ansible-creator and VS Code Ansible extension ¶
files.summary:
- For users who prefer a graphical interface, ansible-creator seamlessly integrates with the [Visual Studio Code (VS Code)](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs) and the [Ansible extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=redhat.ansible) for it, offering an intuitive GUI experience.
- By navigating to the Ansible section in the VS Code activity bar and selecting "Ansible Development Tools," users can access a menu-driven interface.
- This GUI provides interactive forms for straightforward input.

files.title: Execution Environment Scaffolding ¶
files.summary:
The `ansible-creator init execution_env` command scaffolds a complete Execution Environment (EE) project, including the EE definition file, a CI/CD workflow for **GitHub Actions** (default) or **GitLab CI**, and optional configuration for Ansible Galaxy servers.

## Quick start ¶

```
ansible-creator init execution_env my-ee-project
```

This produces a GitHub Actions–based project:

```
my-ee-project/
├── .github/
│   └── workflows/
│       └── ee-build.yml
├── .gitignore
├── README.md
└── execution-environment.yml
```

### GitLab instead of GitHub ¶

Use `--scm-provider gitlab` to scaffold `.gitlab-ci.yml` instead of `.github/workflows/ee-build.yml`:

```
ansible-creator init execution_env --scm-provider gitlab my-ee-gitlab
```

```
my-ee-gitlab/
├── .gitlab-ci.yml
├── .gitignore
├── README.md
└── execution-environment.yml
```

Galaxy and SCM tokens use the **same variable names** as in the GitHub workflow (`ANSIBLE_GALAXY_SERVER_<ID>_TOKEN`, plus each `scm_servers[*].token_env_var`).
